However, the comment does not explicitly identify which section, page, or other specific location of the paper the quoted text comes from; it only quotes the text without pinpointing where it appears. As such, the authors cannot confidently determine which part of the paper the comment addresses, though an educated guess (the definition of individual fairness) is possible. Regarding specificity, the comment does not clearly explain what is wrong or missing in the quoted part; it merely states 'I am not sure how this relates to the former sentence. Doesn't really make sense.' without detailing the issue. Thus the comment specifies only vaguely what needs to be addressed, since it does not explain what the problem is or how the passage should be revised.
